verdict.rationale: Zulip's own docs describe 'a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages', which you can write as custom bots and deploy in production with the Zulip Botserver. That means bots receive incoming messages through Zulip's API. The evidence never names an events API, event queue, or gateway/streaming connection, and never says which event types beyond messages are delivered or how real-time delivery works. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a real-time events API/long-poll or gateway mechanism, coverage of non-message event types, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time bot event delivery.
